reviews.text: Dr Smith is fantastic and knowledgeable but the rest of the staff leaves something to be desired with their lack of business etiquette and their concerns over your time and money!!  The doctor was out of the office and they failed to call to notify and reschedule my appointment!  I drove nearly an hour to find out she had an emergency come up!
Great Staff very knowledgeable, good prices, Friendly,
Thank you!

The vet seems knowledgeable and experienced, which is why I returned when my cat started acting strange and stopped eating. However, I didn’t feel that my cat received particularly thoughtful care.

The office itself feels disorganized. Staff often lack a sense of urgency when handling sick pets. Upon entering, there can be a long delay before anyone acknowledges you. During my visit, my cat was actively vomiting in her cage, yet the vet continued talking as if it were background noise. There’s also frequent chit-chat between staff and clients, which leads to excessive wait times.

It seems the office could benefit from more staff, as one person often handles check-ins, invoices, phone calls, and vet tech duties, meaning the phone goes unanswered for long periods.

Overall, this is an average place for routine check-ups, but I would not recommend it for injuries or illnesses.
Dr Smith is highly skilled doctor, staff is wonderful,  she saved few of our cats

Doctor Smith has been helping our pets for 10 years even after ours passed with our family friend dogs & rescue she is amazing! She is very knowledgeable and reasonable and extremely extremely good at what she does!!

This Animal hospital of San Antonio is one of the best. Dr. Smith and Rod have done a great job on my cats Simba and Myles. There prices are fair and Dr Smith knowledge of pet issues is top of the line and you can trust your pet will receive some of the best care.
Thanks to the whole team!!!!!
Wife loves this place
Love her been with her for over 20 years! Excellent vet!
Took good care of my Chloey. Very friendly

We had a wonderful experience with the Animal Hospital of San Antonio when we brought our cat, Kiki, for his neuter and vaccinations. From start to finish, the team was kind, professional, and incredibly communicative.
They took the time to explain every step of the process and answered all of my questions with patience and care. I really appreciated how they kept me informed before and after the procedure—it gave me such peace of mind knowing Kiki was in good hands.
Kiki is recovering well and already back to his playful self. I’m so grateful to have found a vet I can trust. Highly recommend them for anyone looking for compassionate, quality care!
(Photo taken the morning after the procedure.)
The staff and vet were very nice.
Everyone that works there is awesome! Great people and the vet is very informative and easy to talk with.
Friendly, experienced and knowledgeable!

I had made an appointment for Tuesday but when my cat took a turn for the worse, they managed to see her on Saturday, for which I'm extremely grateful. The Doctor was very frank and up front and my cat's outcome has been really good. Also it was very affordable and I couldn't be happier.
Always a joy to see you.
The staff here are absolutely amazing! I am beyond words at how well they treated my dog. You definitely won’t be disappointed in their care and service.
Great staff and pricing!
Thank you and hugs and kisses to your furry buddy.

Traumatizing! older female vet with the shakes has GOT to retire because she causes a hemorrhage in my dog because she was shaking so bad and also made half my poor babies nails bleed profusely because she shakes so dang bad when cutting nails. Dont bring your pup here! There are much better places to go that won't traumatize your babies.
Dr. Smith has always been very good to our dogs, we respect her opinion, experience and knowledge.

I came here on a whim trying to find care for my elderly cat and kittens. They took me in immediately and I couldn't be happier. I'm now getting my cat created through their services and memorial care. Thank yall !

I love Dr. Smith, Rod, and the staff!  They honestly care about your pet and you as well.  Dr. Smith tells you straight up how to take care of your pet, not just what you want to hear.  She has added years to my blue heelers life and I am forever grateful.
They are the absolute best! So caring and compassionate! They take the time to explain EVERYTHING. Take your fur babies there and you won't be disappointed.

I will not be coming back here ever again, Nor would I EVER let a vet who has insane tremors put a needle in my cat ever again. She was shaking like no other the entire time! Gave my cat hematomas in both his legs and his neck. Would definitely say she is not the hands I would trust to take care of my animals ever again. She was also very passive aggressive with her assistances and you could feel the tension her assistants felt when she entered the room. Did not feel right the way she would talk to them. They couldn’t even look at me when she had the needle in my cats neck shaking because they could see how uncomfortable it made me. But they obviously didn’t feel like they could say anything to her because she is so aggressive.
I take my pets here because they care about what they do and make things easy, including scheduling. Highly recommend.
Vet Dr n staff are awesome n friendly

Dr. Smith is the best in the business! We sure do appreciate all she has done every time our cat gets beat up in a fight or is sick or just needs routine care. Just so compassionate and caring, I am so happy we found Dr. Smith and Animal Hospital of San Antonio.
